notes: Nearby certain anchors vote for local source-to-target displacement instead of imposing document-wide order.
Landmarks only vote within the same source heading path, allowing sections to move independently.
Only ambiguous exact candidates can be promoted; edited or weakly supported candidates remain fuzzy or ambiguous.
The implementation uses portable deterministic data structures and is exported from both Node and browser entrypoints.
Generated workloads do not currently contain coordinated duplicate-comment scenarios, so their accuracy remains unchanged.
